name: Debug Code
description: Find why code fails and fix the cause, and turn logs, stack traces and crash reports into a diagnosis with its evidence and the next check.
abilities: Reproduces the failure before changing anything
Reads tracebacks and error messages from the bottom frame up
Narrows the cause one hypothesis at a time, with the evidence for each
Fixes the smallest thing that explains every symptom, and adds a test that would have caught it
Summarizes a large log with log_summary.py: levels, time span, repeated messages grouped
Builds a timeline and finds the first error, not the loudest one
Follows one request through the log by its id
Gives a cause with its evidence and how sure it is, and the next check to confirm it
permissions: Uses Code Sandbox: reads and runs code in your private, network-isolated sandbox
Reads logs you paste or attach, or files in your workspace; uses Code Sandbox for large files

changes.notes: Adds bounded workflows, deterministic conflict combination, native read-only inspection and measured agent results.
Clarifies Bash versus inspection commands, trusted Python subprocesses and mutually exclusive edit forms.
Adds native independent task, staged merge, scoped package and parallel read composition guidance.
Adds version-checked V4A previews and bounded native agent supervision guidance.
Merged with Logs to Diagnosis, which is part of this skill now.
